chunks.text: KIAN, the Knowledge-Inclusive Attention Network, is built from three components. The inner actor is a normal learnable policy that lets the agent develop its own strategy, so even if every external policy is useless for a task the agent can still find a solution.

chunks.text: Each knowledge policy, including the inner one, is given a learnable embedding vector called its key, which represents the whole policy independent of any state or action.
